in_hebrew.name: חֶמְפִיל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: An Old English personal name, possibly from heafu 'high' and helm 'helmet', or 'hollow hill'.

in_greek.name: Ἑμφίλος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek ἑμιδέω (hemidéō), meaning 'to love, to have affection for'. The name Hemphill may not have a direct Greek origin but is similar in meaning.

in_latin.name: Hemphillus
